title: Zara Larsson Brings Her Y2K Closet to Life With New Baby Tees, Low-Rise Jeans and Merch
summary: After her early-aughts wardrobe became an instant hit on Depop, the Swedish pop powerhouse is letting fans shop the same Y2K aesthetic through her latest merch collections.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Zara Larsson season is officially here. The Swedish pop star is having a major 2026, with her latest Midnight Sun era bringing together chart-topping music , festival performances at Lollapalooza and All Things Go and a growing fashion moment. For fans looking to channel Larsson’s signature Y2K style, there are plenty of new pieces to shop. 

Earlier this week, the singer launched a limited Depop drop featuring pieces from her personal early-aughts wardrobe alongside upcycled Midnight Sun merch, with proceeds benefiting charity. The collection sold out within minutes, but fans can still shop her nostalgic aesthetic through official merch, including baby tees, low-rise jeans and her recently restocked True Religion collaboration now on sale.

BEDAZZLED MOMENT

Joey Low Rise Crystal Flap Cut-Off Short

$89.99 $134 33% off

Buy Now at true religion

Only sizes 24 to 28 are still in stock.

True Religion is bringing back the Y2K denim trend with these crystal-adorned cut-off shorts. With a low-rise fit, eye-catching embellishments and signature horseshoe stitching, they’re made for festival season.

Y2K STAPLE

One-Shoulder Ruched Top

$55.30 $79 30% off

Comes with an adjustable side ruching for a figure hugging fit.

From festival season to a night out, True Religion’s One-Shoulder Ruched Top makes a statement. The asymmetrical neckline, crystal accents and cinched detailing create a flattering look with plenty of Y2K appeal. Choose from a white or black colorway.

POP OF PINK

Jennie Mid Rise Super T Curvy Skinny Jean

$170.80 $244 30% off

Available in sizes 24 to 34.

Your denim collection deserves a pop of personality with True Religion’s Jennie Mid Rise Super T Curvy Skinny Jeans. Designed with pink Super T stitching, clean hardware and horseshoe back pockets, this style puts a playful spin on the classic denim skinny silhouette.

AFFORDABLE FIND

Oversized Zara Larsson Graphic Tee

$20 $29.95 33% off

Buy Now at Hollister

Made from 100% cotton and available in sizes XXS to XXL.

If bold merch isn’t your style, this Hollister graphic tee offers a more understated way to rep Zara Larsson. Crafted from 100% cotton, it features a classic crew neckline, short sleeves and an oversized fit that’s easy to style with everything from low-rise jeans to cargo pants. At just $20, it’s also one of the most affordable picks in the collection and is available in four additional concert-inspired graphics.

HOT PINK DENIM

Joey Mid Rise Pink Flap Flare Jean

$118.30 $169 30% off

A pair of flared jeans with a neon pink overdye wash.

A colorful take on a Y2K favorite, these Joey Mid Rise Pink Flap Flare Jeans pair a mid-rise fit with a flared leg for a nostalgic silhouette. Style them with a baby tee or going-out top to channel Zara Larsson’s signature look. Please note: The crystals on Zara’s pair were hand-bedazzled by the singer and are not included.

BEST SELLER

Zara Larsson Midnight Sun Portrait T-Shirt

$22.41 $24.90 10% off

Buy Now at hot topic

Use code HTEXTRA for 10% off, plus an additional 50% off.

Rep Zara Larsson’s Midnight Sun era with this light pink graphic tee. The front showcases a tonal portrait of the singer wearing her “Connected” tee, along with Zara Larsson’s logo underneath for a subtle nod to the album. Made from 100% cotton, it’s available in unisex sizes XS to 2X.

POP STAR STYLE

Zara Larsson T-Shirt

$19.90

Buy Now at Zara

A mini version of Zara Larsson merch, this tee features front and back prints and comes in kids sizes only.

As Midnight Sun continues its summer takeover, younger fans can celebrate Zara Larsson’s latest era with this graphic tee. The under-$20 style comes with a round neckline, short sleeves, a bright pink logo and a Y2K-inspired portrait of the singer on the back. It’s available in kids sizes for ages six to seven and 11 to 14 years.

Larsson’s latest wave of success marks a major milestone in a career that has been more than a decade in the making. After winning Sweden’s Got Talent in 2008 at just 10 years old, the singer went on to release her debut album in 2014 and quickly became a global pop force with hits including “Never Forget You,” “Lush Life” and “Ain’t My Fault.”

Now, the Swedish singer is reaching new heights with her Midnight Sun album. Larsson recently made Billboard history by becoming the first artist to earn their first two Pop Airplay No. 1 hits in consecutive weeks, with “Stateside” featuring PinkPantheress followed by “Midnight Sun.” The achievement marks another defining moment for an artist who has continued to evolve while building a loyal fan base around the world.

The momentum isn’t slowing down anytime soon. Larsson is set to perform at Lollapalooza and All Things Go this summer, while songs from Midnight Sun continue finding new listeners after being featured throughout the latest season of Love Island USA . Between her chart success, sold-out Depop drop and Y2K-inspired merch, Zara Larsson’s latest era proves she’s entering one of the biggest chapters of her career yet.
